items.title: Bright Sparks Tutoring Agency
bullets: Designed and delivered the public website and enrolment platform for Bright Sparks Tutoring Agency end to end, from requirements and copy through launch and handover.
Built it on Next.js, React and Firebase (Firestore, Auth, Cloud Functions): a multi-step enrolment form with validation, a role-based admin dashboard, and email notifications for new enrolments.
Owned delivery and operations: GitHub Actions deploys to Firebase App Hosting, Cypress end-to-end tests, honeypot and reCAPTCHA v3 bot protection, and a documented daily backup plan for submissions.
